meta.dev_rule: eligible = CONUS Wildfire 2017-2021, >=4 FEDS PM steps, >=2 growth days, FEDS/MTBS area 0.5-1.5, <10% of window covered by other fires, fuel group known; 4 GOFER fires (seeded, one per year first), then per-region n = round(36 x share) (min 1), systematic sampling with seeded start over (fuel group, size class, year)
meta.window_rule: final MTBS perimeter bbox + max(3 km, 0.3 x max side), snapped to the 90 m grid x,y = 15 + 90k (EPSG:5070), aligned with LANDFIRE 30 m cells

rules.unit: the fire (MTBS Event_ID). All time steps of a fire share its split; GOFER and WildfireSpreadTS fires inherit the split of the MTBS fires they overlap (tile and date match); mixed matches are excluded.
rules.dev: Only dev fires may be used to calibrate, gate, tune or choose anything (incl. simulator calibration, replay factors, thresholds, sigma widening). aux_rx (prescribed fires) may be used like dev for simulator calibration only; never scored.
rules.exam: Exam fires are scored once, at the end. Exam progression is never a training target, never used to choose anything. exam_period: early 2012-2016 (LANDFIRE only post-fire, no HRRR), main 2017-2021, recent 2022-2024 (temporal exam: whole seasons held out).
rules.simulation_inputs: Simulated training data may use real landscapes and weather ONLY if (a) the landscape window does not intersect any exam fire footprint (MTBS final perimeter buffered by 2 km; any year, because the landscape IS the fire site), and (b) weather is not taken from within 50 km of an exam fire footprint during that fire's active window [ignition - 3 d, last FEDS step + 3 d] (fire-day weather). Dev fires' own landscapes and weather are free. Random non-fire places at any time are free. Enforce with firedata.guard.check_landscape(bbox) and firedata.guard.check_weather(bbox, t0, t1), which raise ExamLeakError. Footprints: proc/guard/exam_footprints.parquet.
rules.firesize: FireSize universe = FPA-FOD 6th ed. CONUS fires 2012-2020 (Short 2022). A FOD fire with an MTBS_ID inherits that MTBS fire's split. Other FOD fires: dev = seeded 1.5% sample of 2012-2019 (list in firesize.dev_fod_ids); exam = all the rest, with exam_period recent = FIRE_YEAR 2020. Per-fire table: proc/firesize_split.parquet.
